Minor accused of raping infant in Uttar Pradesh

A nine-month-old girl was allegedly abducted and sexually assaulted by her 14-year-old maternal uncle in Gorakhpur, Uttar Pradesh. The accused reportedly took the infant from her home while she slept and she was later found injured in a field. Police apprehended the accused, who claimed to be under the influence of alcohol.
